snippet.title: Can you reach the top? Super Chick
snippet.description:
Can you reach the top in one run?

Super Chick is a challenging 3D precision platformer and climb where every mistake costs height. Master smooth movement, learn the routes, and push higher with every attempt. Play solo or online with friends to practice together or race for cleaner runs.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2985280/Super_Chick/
